integrity: All formulas have self-contained arithmetic and finite-group/incidence arguments with a standalone, exact-arithmetic verifier. Self-review only; no independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Characteristic three excluded; exact claim concerns the reduced open complement of all 27 geometric lines on the Fermat cubic, not arbitrary cubic surfaces. The finite-field point count and line equations are prior work; historical priority of the combined line-complement classification remains qualified.
title: The five point-free fields of the line-free Fermat cubic
